note.zh-TW: 課程的企業績效指標以 ME 代表；這是網站補充的延伸科目，給 ME intensity 等指標使用。台灣報表多列在推銷費用。
note.en: The course’s business performance indicators use ME for it; it is an extension account added by the site for ratios such as marketing expense intensity. Taiwanese statements usually show it under distribution costs.

definition.zh-TW:
為了推廣產品與品牌而花的廣告、活動與促銷支出。

它是營業費用的一種；課程的企業績效指標用它衡量行銷投入的強度。
definition.en:
Spending on advertising, events and promotions to market products and the brand.

It is a type of operating expense; the course’s business performance indicators use it to measure marketing intensity.

example.zh-TW: 位置：損益表銷管費用區。ME intensity 以它為分子。
example.en: Where it sits: the distribution and administrative expenses section of the income statement. Marketing expense intensity uses it as the numerator.

misconception.zh-TW: 以為行銷支出會提高營業成本、壓低毛利。它是營業費用，在毛利之後才扣，影響的是營業利益而不是營業毛利。
misconception.en: Assuming marketing spending raises cost of sales and lowers gross profit. It is an operating expense deducted after gross profit, so it affects operating profit rather than gross profit.
